title: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor

source.epub: ~/Downloads/The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor_ 1st Compilation -- NAM Heesung -- The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor 1, 2017 -- d902199879d0f6204814ff5f0f3fc400 -- Anna’s Archive.epub
source.nextStart: The civilization of the Versailles Continent dawned approximately one million and eight thousand years ago.
source.nextEndBefore: Several high level users saw through Weed’s intentions to improve strength and other stats.
source.continuationNote: Compress the four-race history faithfully as context, then the four-week training rumor and users mistaking Weed for a quest NPC. He refuses offered gifts and explains he is a user; the misunderstanding grows. Stop before high-level recruitment.

completed.end: Hyun lists Weed at 50,000 won for one day, then sleeps.
CTS Media buys Weed for 3,090,000,000 won. Hyun verifies the money and shares the bankbook and hope with Grandmother. Stop before moving and hospital treatment.
Debt collectors take three billion won, return 90 million and the IOU, and leave after Han Jinsup’s five-year challenge. Stop before the three days of despair.

On the third day Hyun finds hope of earning again. Ninety million remains, fifty million is reserved for the house contract, forty million is available. He will not pay a cancellation penalty. Stops before registering for martial arts.

Hyun completes a year of martial-arts training and game research. Royal Road reaches over 75% of the global game market and over 90% of Korean gamers; its royal wars dominate broadcasts. He is satisfied it has developed as expected. Stop before his cold gaze at the monitor and buying the capsule.

Hyun buys the capsule for ten million won, immediately says Yes, creates Weed as a male human without changing his appearance, selects Serabourg in Rosenheim, and skips the introduction to save time at three hundred thousand won per month. Stops before the flash and arrival in the city.
Arrival in Serabourg, public movement tests, humiliation and decision to go to Training Hall. Stops before instructor introduction.
Instructor guidance, repeated dummy strikes, first strength +1 after six hours and first stats window. Level remains 1, strength is 11. Stops before -Five hours later-.
Vitality and agility each rise by one; Hyun opens inventory with water and ten rye breads, eats briefly and returns to dummy training despite onlookers. Stop before the scarecrow shivering question.

The onlookers debate training; Pluto explains persistent benefits, estimated forty-point strength limit and the time cost. Hyun enjoys progress and continues; the instructor silently approves. Stop before the three-week jump.

After three weeks of game time, Fighting Spirit and Endurance appear; Sword Mastery is Beginner level 3 at 0%, with +30% attack power and +9% attack speed. Gains are STR +28, AGI +25, VIT +22. Hyun resolves to finish before the four-week city restriction ends. Stop before the hunger interruption.
Hunger and dwindling bread lead Hyun to flatter the instructor, share his lunch and recognize their growing affinity. Stop before the Sculpture Mastery question.

Over lunch Hyun echoes the instructor’s disdain for Sculpture Mastery, wins greater affinity, and privately recognizes their shared criticism as a shortcut to approval. Stops before the moonlight-carving rumor.

The instructor describes the moonlight-carving rumor, names his predecessor Mellium as a Royal Knight, and asks Hyun to investigate. The E-level quest offer appears with friendship, no Sculpture Mastery, and dedication-to-sword conditions. It is not accepted yet.

Hyun recognizes the rare quest conditions, accepts the E-level investigation, receives two silver coins as an advance, and is advised to begin at the sculpture shop. Stops before the bread-price calculation.

Weed calculates that two silver coins buy sixty-six breads plus change, fills his canteen, walks the city and enters the sculpture shop. The shopkeeper judges his clothing, refuses to hear his question and tells him to leave. Weed slowly retreats toward the doorway; no flattery or statue examination yet.

Weed praises the golden two-headed eagle and professes artistic interest, winning an invitation to sit and talk. The keeper gives him cold honeyed water and permission to tour the statues. Stops before Weed privately evaluates sculpting as a business; the moonlight question is still unasked.

Weed privately dismisses sculpting as a poor way to earn money, asks about moonlight carving fifty years ago, and hears confirmation from the keeper via reliable royal patrons. The E-level investigation completes; reward remains unclaimed. He intends to return to the instructor but has not left.

The keeper asks Weed to investigate the late Queen Evane and the sculptor. Weed recognizes a serial quest, weighs the Royal Knights’ hostility and his level-one limits, accepts after reassurance, and is directed to a bard. Still inside the shop; no bard visit or payment yet.

Weed finds a middle-aged native bard after searching pubs. Flattery fails; he accidentally produces a silver coin without having made change, and the bard takes it. Weed learns the queen and sculptor loved each other since childhood and realizes why the Royal Knights might silence the inquiry. Still with the bard; no village history or promise yet.

The bard tells Weed of Zahab and the queen’s childhood, gifts, separation and promise. He corrects Weed’s assumption that the promise failed: she called his later work the world’s most beautiful. The bard refers Weed to the living eyewitness maid; no directions or visit yet.

Weed visits the retired attendant. Her eyewitness account explains the queen’s initial heartbreak when Zahab arrived carrying a sword instead of a carving knife. Weed understands the apparent broken trust but does not yet know how the sword fulfilled the promise. Stops before the assassination account.

The attendant recounts the assassination, Zahab’s moonlight carving and song, the queen’s tears and fleeing assassins. Weed understands how the sword fulfilled the promise. Stop before the system flashback.

The flashback confirms Zahab’s promise; The Sculptor’s Past completes and Weed rises from level one to three. He refuses Moonlight Sculptor twice to pursue income, thanks the attendant, and accepts an offered present. No items, new skills or A-level quest yet.

Weed receives Zahab’s carving knife and wooden statue. Follow Zahab’s Last Wish arrives as an uncancellable A-level quest: become a master sculptor, find Zahab, learn A Sculpture’s Heart and sing it to the attendant before she dies. Gray Pass is forbidden and extremely dangerous. He gains Item Identification, Sculpture Mastery, Repair and Handicraft without changing class, and has two quest slots left. Still at the attendant’s home; no farewell or rewards collected.

Weed leaves the attendant, receives two silver coins from the shopkeeper and one from the instructor. Five silver earned gross including the original two; after the bard’s one-silver payment, four remain. Still level three; level-up bonus points divided equally between Strength and Agility. Tempted by further quests, he picks up the wooden sword and returns to training. Chapter 3 complete.

continuity: Grandmother remains hospitalized and the old debt is paid. Do not invent an exact current balance.
Training stats and Sword Mastery remain unchanged; Weed is now level three after The Sculptor’s Past. The four-week restriction has not expired.
The Sculptor’s Past is complete. Zahab’s mastery and fulfilled promise are confirmed.
Weed twice refused Moonlight Sculptor for financial reasons; no class conversion.
Weed has the carving knife and wooden statue, four practical skills, and uncancellable A-level Zahab’s Last Wish. No class conversion; his level remains three. Two quest slots remain.
He must learn A Sculpture’s Heart from Zahab and return to sing it before the attendant dies. Zahab was last seen heading for Gray Pass.
Both shopkeeper and instructor rewards are now collected. Gross earned silver is five including the original advance; the bard took one, leaving four. No further spending.
Level-up bonus points are split equally into Strength and Agility; no invented numeric point allocation. Still level three.
Weed has returned to dummy training with his wooden sword. Chapter 3 is complete.
Episode 26 has four immediate-response choices and no saved variables.
